legal_questions: Does the official TED/EU reuse framework permit the bounded campaign with the contextual contact-channel policy?
Are source acknowledgement and transformation/change disclosures sufficient?
May institutional and functional non-personal channels be retained as opportunity-scoped references?
May professional-personal channels be used only in the same published procurement procedure under the stated restrictions?
Are source-link-only handling, attachment exclusions and mark/logo prohibitions adequate?
What additional jurisdictional, attribution or retention conditions apply?
privacy_data_rights_questions: What lawful basis permits any professional-personal contact processing?
Is same-procedure necessity plus purpose limitation sufficiently narrow?
What retention, deletion, quarantine and access-control periods apply?
How must correction, erasure, objection and restriction requests propagate?
Must sole traders and ambiguous legal forms remain excluded automatically?
Which logs, metrics and traces may be retained without replicating personal endpoints?
Is a DPIA or records-of-processing update required before execution?
proposed_conditions: institutional and functional channels remain tenant and opportunity scoped
professional-personal channels remain contextual to the same procurement procedure
ambiguous personal endpoints are not persisted and degrade to source-link-only or block
natural-person tenderers and contractors remain blocked
no global person search, bulk export, marketing or cross-opportunity reuse
no endpoint or message-body replication in audit events
no autonomous external communication or bid submission
raw payloads remain ephemeral and are not persisted
attachments and third-party works remain disabled
public API redistribution and model training remain denied
any head, tree, manifest, contract or artifact change invalidates approval
